stem: Compound **F** contains the elements carbon, hydrogen and oxygen only. All carbon-carbon bonds in **F** are single bonds. The structure of **F** was analysed by mass spectrometry and infra-red and NMR spectroscopy.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
The mass spectrum shows that the $m/e$ value for the M peak is 90.

The ratio of the heights of the M and M+1 peaks is 22.1 : 0.7.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Use the ratio of the heights of the M and M+1 peaks to calculate the number of carbon atoms in a molecule of **F**.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The infra-red spectrum of **F** was obtained.

Use the *Data Booklet* and your knowledge of infra-red spectroscopy to identify the type of bond and the functional group responsible for these **three** absorptions.

| absorption/$\text{cm}^{-1}$ | appearance of the peak | type of bond | functional group |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 3350 | broad and strong |  |  |
| 2680 | very broad and strong |  |  |
| 1725 | strong |  |  |

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Describe and explain the splitting pattern for the absorption at $\delta = 1.4$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
**F** was dissolved in $\text{D}_2\text{O}$ and the proton NMR spectrum of this new solution obtained. Two of the absorptions in Table 1 were not present in this spectrum.

Which absorptions were **not** present?

parts.stem: Molecules of cycloheptadiene, $\text{C}_7\text{H}_{10}$, consist of a seven-membered ring with two carbon-carbon double bonds.
